about: Canary values (DESIGN §9, §10.2). They are fed into the synthetic fixtures and the virtual iPhone. After every fixture E2E a scan looks for each value in all events, reports, logs, session.json/engine.json and the diagnostic report: byte-wise, as UTF-8, UTF-16 and Base64. Allowed hits: the fixture input files and android/missing-senders.json. All values are synthetic.
message_text: Kanarienmeldung zz-7f3a: Der Zitronenfalter wartet am Gleis 9
udid_note: join udid_parts with '-' to get the UDID-shaped canary; stored split so the repo never holds a UDID-shaped string
